_doc: Tracked flag combinations. The daily job counts each one exactly (unsampled) per key per day and appends to data/daily_key_counts.csv. status: live = TT exists in Dataswan; candidate = drafted, not created; Add new combos from the discovery scan here. The FIRST flag of each combo is the pre-filter anchor in 03_track_exact_day.sql: it is matched against SUSPICION_FLAGS and TELLTALE_LIST_AT_ALL_EVENTS and should be the rarest one.

combos.action_detail: Weekend, Oct 16-18: NOT mitigated. Adobe ARP grew to 959k (Oct 16), 1.42M (Oct 17) and 902k (Oct 18), with 59-75% verified. The TT fires, but most of the traffic still gets through. It peaked at 168k/h on Oct 18 12:00 UTC (83% verified) and was down to ~3-4k/h by midnight. This is the top ask: change the action on this key. New keys: WBD Account Lookup (Key 20) 435k on Oct 18 (23% verified; bursts at 06h, 08-09h and 18-20h with a 188k/h peak). WBD Login (Key 8) 203k on Oct 18 (39% verified; 40k/h at 18h and 54k/h at 21-22h). Olo Payments 10k (5% verified, still running). Roblox Signup is steady at ~40k/day.

Weekend: same actor as the live TT, and still ongoing. Adobe ARP 965k / 1.43M / 907k on Oct 16-18 (59-75% verified). New keys on Oct 18: WBD Login (Key 8) 103k (77% verified) and WBD Account Lookup (Key 20) 79k (22% verified). Uber SMS is steady at ~90-110k/day (3-4% verified, so mostly blocked). gtop100 is back at 27k (61% verified). Adobe Sign-in (~400k/day at 97% verified, its normal level) dropped to ~40k/day on Oct 17-18, so exclude that key or watch it.

Weekend: Adobe ARP came back to its highest level yet, 251k on Oct 18 (74% verified; 103k/h at 12h). New key: AT&T Consumer SDK Android, 30k on Oct 18 at 0% verified (a 2-hour burst at 09-10h UTC). Roblox Signup 115k on Oct 16 (0% verified), then ~35-45k/day. Wells Fargo Login is steady at 13-31k/day (~73% verified, getting through). Olo Payments is new from Oct 17 (12k on Oct 18, 0% verified, ongoing). Adobe Sign-in 17-20k/day at 99% verified (likely benign).

Weekend: only GitLab Sign Up (43k on Oct 16 and 18k on Oct 17, 0% verified, the same GitLab attack as the ja4-dict1 combo), stopped by Oct 18. Nothing is live now. Keep scoped to Adobe Sign Up and Roblox Game Join (the recurring keys); low priority.

Weekend: Roblox Signup had its biggest wave so far, 209k on Oct 18 (19% verified). It ran 19-39k/h from 08 to 13h and again 6-12k/h from 18 to 23h UTC: its 6th burst since Sep 29. New key: Tinder PreSMS, 19k on Oct 17 and 3.7k on Oct 18, 0% verified. Roblox Game Join is quiet since its Oct 15 burst. Microsoft Signup is fading (2.5k, 0% verified). Scope to Roblox Signup + Game Join first.

Weekend: Roblox Signup's Oct 15 wave (135k) faded to 30k on Oct 16 and 1.8k on Oct 17, then came back at 21k on Oct 18 (20% verified). Uber SMS is back to ~50k/day, but only 4% verified now (was 42% on Oct 15), so it is being stopped. New on Oct 18: Roblox Login 14k (1% verified) and Amazon IDS 11k (18% verified). gtop100 is steady at ~20k (83% verified).
